mapper.sql: id::text AS id, name, cron, schedule_kind, schedule_value, task_kind AS task_type, lane, payload::text AS payload_json, enabled, priority, max_attempts, timezone, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_run_at) AS next_run_at, last_task_id::text AS last_task_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM last_run_at) AS last_run_at, last_error, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updated_at) AS updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_schedules WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) ORDER BY name ASC

INSERT INTO task_schedules( user_id, name, cron, schedule_kind, schedule_value, task_kind, lane, payload, enabled, priority, max_attempts, timezone, next_run_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cron, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{scheduleKind, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{scheduleValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taskType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lane, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{payload, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{enabled}, #{priority}, #{maxAttempts}, #{timezone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, to_timestamp(#{nextRunAt}), now() ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, name) DO UPDATE SET cron = EXCLUDED.cron, schedule_kind = EXCLUDED.schedule_kind, schedule_value = EXCLUDED.schedule_value, task_kind = EXCLUDED.task_kind, lane = EXCLUDED.lane, payload = EXCLUDED.payload, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, max_attempts = EXCLUDED.max_attempts, timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone, next_run_at = EXCLUDED.next_run_at, last_error = NULL, updated_at = now() RETURNING

SELECT FROM task_schedules WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND enabled = true AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= now() ORDER BY next_run_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT id::text AS id, user_id::text AS owner_user_id, name, cron, schedule_kind, schedule_value, task_kind AS task_type, lane, payload::text AS payload_json, enabled, priority, max_attempts, timezone, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_run_at) AS next_run_at, last_error FROM task_schedules WHERE enabled = true AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= now() ORDER BY next_run_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE task_schedules SET next_run_at = to_timestamp(#{nextRunAt}), last_task_id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), last_run_at = now(), last_error = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND id = CAST(#{scheduleId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

UPDATE task_schedules SET last_task_id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), last_run_at = now(), last_error = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND name = #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

UPDATE task_schedules SET enabled = false, last_error = #{error, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND id = CAST(#{scheduleId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND enabled = true
